name: feed-subscriber-app-ui
description: Component-mode frontend for aw-app-feed-subscriber — owns the Feed Subscriber window body (core.window.body:feed-subscriber.main), a per-card CRUD form talking to this app's own /cards + /agents routes. src/plugin.jsx is the integrated-mode entry (register(host)), built as a Vite lib-mode bundle consumed by aw-app.json's contributes.frontend.bundle.
